_comment: ONE Cocreation brand layer — TASK-262/TASK-302. Room id -> { title, note }. Matched against ?room= or ?director=/&dir=, after normalizeRoomId() (onecocreation.js), which mirrors the fork's own sanitizeRoomName() (lib.js:3747-3757: hyphens/non-word chars -> underscore, 30-char cap) — so a hyphenated key already matches an underscore param and vice versa. Both forms are listed here anyway per the T-264 underscore-native ruling (TASK-292 DESIGN.md SLOP #5): new room ids mint underscore-native, and the site mints onecocreation_studio (underscore). An id not listed here is shown raw (derive-or-dash) — never invent a name for it.
